svg.title: Inter-Region Couplings: Discrete Region Exchange vs Surface RKKY / Interlayer Exchange
svg.desc: Two-panel comparison of Fullmag inter-region couplings: (a) cell-to-cell harmonic and explicit exchange link operator across adjacent ObjectRegion cells (executable on FDM GPU and FDM CPU AoS reference, unsupported on FEM), and (b) opposing-surface bilinear/biquadratic RKKY and interlayer exchange energy across ferromagnetic, antiferromagnetic, 90-degree, and canted regimes (authored_only IR contract rejected by strict runtime on all lanes).
svg.text: Inter-Region Couplings: Cell-Link Region Exchange vs Authored Surface RKKY
